mission: Migrate the complete owner-authorized vehicle fleets and reusable vehicle assets from the Yardman project source pool into the private vehicle-production pipeline. Do not cherry-pick a small hero roster and do not import source-game map/world geography.
non_negotiable_rules: Every discovered vehicle from the owner-authorized Yardman project source pool enters the migration queue or an explicit evidence-backed duplicate/no-match state.
Do not silently reject a car for poor geometry, materials, missing dependencies, excessive cost, or incomplete LODs; keep it queued in an explicit repair/block state.
Preserve source identity and provenance. Do not cosmetically relabel one model or generation as another.

There is no brand-specific exclusion inside the owner-authorized project source pool; Porsche and Tesla are evaluated under the same source, identity, quality, physics, audio and Android gates as other brands.
Do not ingest source-game maps, terrain/world layouts, road networks as replacement geography, or settlement/world geography.
Do not introduce third-party assets from outside the owner-provided Yardman source pool unless the owner explicitly approves that source.
Private source media stays outside public Git. Public Git may contain tools, manifests, measurements, generated original proxies, and non-media evidence.
No fleet integration may destabilize the main Android optimization lane or core island streaming.
No APK is produced merely because a vehicle batch completes.
Quantity is not artificially capped; each distinct vehicle may remain if it passes the same quality and runtime gates.
Exact motorsport variants may ship as player-selectable private-garage vehicles; when marked player-only they must not enter AI-driver or ambient-traffic pools.

source_fleets.scope: ALL recoverable vehicle families and their required vehicle-part/material/texture/audio dependencies
source_fleets.migration_policy: all discovered vehicle families queued; variants remain separate until identity/dependency analysis proves they are duplicates or cosmetic derivatives

source_fleets.scope: ALL recoverable vehicle families and their required vehicle-part/material/texture/audio dependencies
source_fleets.migration_policy: all discovered player, rival, traffic, service, police, truck and other vehicle families queued when they contain recoverable vehicle assets

source_fleets.scope: ALL cars in the recovered catalog and all car-prefixed source bundles, plus required wheel/material/texture/interior/audio dependencies
source_fleets.migration_policy: catalog-wide extraction; Crown catalog 218 is only a validated reference example, not the fleet boundary; historical brand exclusions are evidence history, not current eligibility gates

source_fleets.scope: ALL recoverable cars and required vehicle dependencies from the owner's RR3 source
source_fleets.migration_policy: use validated ZIP64 inventory and random-access LZMA2 reset-window recovery; queue every useful exact vehicle/component candidate without full-archive expansion and without brand filtering

source_fleets.source: owner-provided vehicle generation scripts and geometry scaffolds
source_fleets.scope: procedural dimensional/proportion baselines and original generated geometry
source_fleets.migration_policy: procedural scaffolds establish deterministic dimensions/anchors but do not bypass the normal production quality gate

LOD0.quality_rule: hero fidelity has priority; this target is not a hard cap and must not force visible degradation

default_lod_policy.optimization_rule: reduce cost through LOD transitions, texture residency, pooling, dormant physics and AI/traffic eligibility before sacrificing player-facing close-range quality

batching.unit: vehicle family or exact distinct variant
batching.reason: large enough for throughput while keeping render evidence, provenance and failures attributable per car
batching.promotion: cars pass independently; one broken car does not block extraction/conversion of the rest of a batch

report_per_vehicle: exact commit/checkpoint containing public tooling/evidence and exact private checkpoint containing media
